rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: vināśya (perishable) + īśa (lord) + āyatta (subject to, dependent on) + tva-rūpāṃ (whose nature/form, acc. sg. f.); describes the object of niścitya in L1/L2
gerund of niś-ci (to ascertain, determine); L1/L2 supports the act of determining/cognizing
3rd sg. pres. act. of majj (to sink, plunge); main verb in L1/L2
indeclinable adverb (from that, therefore, then); indicates consequence in L1/L2

compound (acc. sg. f.): saṃsāra-bhāgin (partaking in saṃsāra) + iya (state of being) + tathā (such) + niścaya (certainty) + śātinīm (destroying, from śā/śātay, acc. sg. f.); qualifies the result/state in L1/L2
